name: @openscreeps/openapi
description: Source-derived HTTP OpenAPI contracts for Screeps World and OpenScreeps

scripts.check: node scripts/build.mjs --check && node scripts/check.mjs && redocly lint openapi.yaml && node --test test/*.test.mjs
scripts.types: openapi-typescript openapi.yaml -o build/api.d.ts && tsc --noEmit --target es2024 --module nodenext --moduleResolution nodenext build/api.d.ts
